infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) uses the camera to photograph a dish for a recipe or cookbook, or a printed recipe so its ingredients and steps can be imported. For example, take a picture of your lasagna and attach it to the lasagna recipe.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) uses photos you choose to show a picture on a recipe or cookbook cover, and to import a recipe from a photo of a printed or handwritten recipe. For example, select a photo of chocolate cake to display on your chocolate cake recipe.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) uses speech recognition to turn what you say into recipe text. For example, say “2 cups flour” and it is added as an ingredient.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) uses the microphone so you can dictate a recipe instead of typing it. For example, say the ingredients and steps for banana bread and they are added to the recipe.
